summary: C.M.P. Degree College invites online applications from eligible Indian citizens for the recruitment of 33 Assistant Professor posts across various subjects. Candidates must apply online through the official website and submit the hard copy of the application along with relevant documents by December 15, 2026. Qualifications and reservations are governed by UGC Regulations and Government of India rules.
eligibility_bullets: Qualifications as per UGC Regulations, 2018 or as amended up to the date of advertisement.
Reservation norms applicable for SC, ST, OBC (Non-Creamy Layer), EWS, and PwBD categories as per GoI guidelines.
PwBD candidates must have a relevant disability of not less than 40%.
how_to_apply_steps: Visit the official college website recruitment portal at www.cmpcollege.ac.in.
Read the general instructions and detailed advertisement carefully before filling out the online application form.
Fill in all required personal and academic details and upload necessary scanned documents and certificates.
Pay the prescribed application and registration/processing fee online via credit/debit card, net banking, or UPI.
Submit the online application form on or before 08.12.2026.

Print a hard copy of the completed online application and mail it along with self-attested copies of all relevant documents via Speed Post to The Principal, C.M.P. Degree College, M.G. Marg, George Town, Prayagraj, Uttar Pradesh – 211002 on or before 15.12.2026.
